title: Portrayal marked-up drawing (v1)
description: An annotated drawing as one document of CSS selectors over a compiled face: what kit/marks.js normalise() returns, encode() carries in a URL and apply() draws.

device.description: The device the selectors are written against, by its library name; empty for none.

config.description: The configuration of that device; empty for its default.

view.description: Which face: front, rear, or another view the device has; empty for its default.

legend.description: Whether a legend strip is drawn. An object is a legend with options and reads as true.

crop.description: A region of the face, in millimetres of its drawing, or null for the whole face.

swaps.description: What the reader seated before marking up: bay or cage path to component ref, null for one emptied. Only what differs from the configuration's build.

fields.description: What the reader wrote on parts: part path to {field: value}, null for a value cleared.

rect.description: A rectangle in millimetres of the face's drawing.

mark.description: One statement about the parts a selector matches.

id.description: A name for the mark, kept as given; empty when it has none.

select.description: A CSS selector over the compiled drawing, e.g. [data-path='psu-0'].

color.description: Ink: a ring drawn around the matched parts, as a CSS colour; empty for none.

state.description: A lamp state the matched parts show, from their contract's vocabulary; empty for none.

label.description: Text for the legend; empty for none.

lamp.description: The colour the lamp itself shows, as lower-case hex; empty for however the drawing paints it.
